history.body: Hi, saw the Pearl Residences ad. We’re only exploring for now—could you tell me what kind of home it is?

Pearl Residences’ Phase 1 homes are Type A: 900 sq. ft., with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. That gives you separate bedroom space alongside a shared living area. Are you exploring for your own stay or as an investment?
For our own stay if we move. We’re just seeing what’s available for now; there’s no rush.

Makes sense—no rush. For your own stay, the 3-bedroom layout could give you flexibility for family, guests or a work room, alongside a shared living area. If you do move, what would matter most in a home day to day?
A bit more usable space in the shared area and a quiet corner for work would be nice. Our current place is okay, though, so we’re not in a rush.

A quiet work corner could potentially be one of the bedrooms, keeping it separate from the shared living area. Since the feel of that shared space is important to you, I’d suggest a relaxed viewing so you can judge the actual layout for yourself—no need to make a decision on the spot. Would you be open to that?
I’d be open to considering it, but I’d need to talk it over with my spouse first. We’re not ready to arrange anything yet.

Of course—there’s no need to arrange anything now. Since the shared space and a quiet work corner matter to you, it could be useful to look at the layout together with your spouse whenever you’re both comfortable. You can see whether the 3-bedroom arrangement feels workable for you in person.
